The '''LPL 2014 Summer''' was the second split of the 2014 [[LoL Pro League]] (''LPL'') season, organized by Tencent Games and Riot Games from 14 June to 24 August 2014 in Shanghai. Eight teams competed in a Double Round Robin {{Abbr/Bo2}} Group Stage, with the top four advancing to a Single Elimination {{Abbr/Bo5}} Playoffs bracket. Six teams entered through the [[LPL/2014/Spring|Spring]] split, while two—[[Team WE Academy]] and [[Young Glory]]—qualified from the [[LSPL/2014/Spring|LSPL Spring]] season. Notable offseason changes included the formation of [[Star Horn Royal Club]] following the acquisition of Royal Club’s roster and brand by SHRC. The top four teams secured places in the 2015 China Regional Finals, while the bottom two were sent to the [[LPL/2015/Spring/Promotion|Spring Promotion]] tournament.
